description: This Swift source file manages keychain storage for push relay registration data, including registration state and key IDs, providing methods to save, load, and clear data related to push relay registration and associated credentials.
external_methods: KeychainStore.saveString(String, service: String, account: String) -> Bool

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads the registration state from the keychain, decoding stored JSON data into a RegistrationState object.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Saves the given RegistrationState object into the keychain as a JSON string.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state entry from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored App Attest Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Stores the provided App Attest Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the App Attest Key ID from the keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored Attested Key ID from the keychain, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Stores the provided Attested Key ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the Attested Key ID from the keychain.
